subject.title: Memory MVP: define SQLite schema and canonical record model

question: Should memory-core’s durable memory source of truth move from Markdown files to a plugin-owned typed SQLite record model for the MVP, and what migration/review/provenance contract must ship with it?
rationale: The request defines a persisted memory data model that affects user state, migration boundaries, provenance, review/forget flows, and the open Memory MVP sibling issues; automation should not choose that product contract alone.

options.title: Approve plugin-owned SQLite MVP contract
options.body: Define the v1 schema/status/revision/provenance contract first, then implement it in memory-core with explicit migration and review boundaries.

options.title: Keep Markdown canonical for now
options.body: Continue treating SQLite as retrieval/index infrastructure around Markdown durable memory and narrow or close this schema request later.

options.title: Defer until memory convergence
options.body: Keep this as design backlog until maintainers choose the recommended memory plugin path called out in VISION.md.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-owned SQLite MVP contract
recommendation.body: Define the v1 schema/status/revision/provenance contract first, then implement it in memory-core with explicit migration and review boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history signal on the current memory storage, docs, flush, and plugin-slot model this request would replace or migrate.
